package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"
)

// marker is the text the second kit refuses wherever a payload holds it.
const marker = "second-kit-deny"

// The second kit of A13: a binary of its own with its own hook entry, which
// refuses what it recognizes and allows everything else, in the answer of
// the agent its one argument names.
func main() {
	input, err := io.ReadAll(os.Stdin)
	if err != nil || len(os.Args) != 2 {
		fail("second kit: unreadable input")
	}
	denied := bytes.Contains(input, []byte(marker))
	switch os.Args[1] {
	case "codex":
		if denied {
			deny("second kit: denied")
		}
	case "cursor":
		answer := `{"permission":"allow"}`
		if denied {
			answer = `{"permission":"deny","user_message":"segundo kit: negado","agent_message":"second kit: denied"}`
		}
		if _, err := fmt.Println(answer); err != nil {
			os.Exit(1)
		}
	default:
		fail("second kit: unknown agent")
	}
}

// deny is the Codex denial that blocks through every shell: the deny JSON
// with exit 0 and the reason on stderr (D5 as the owner amended it on
// 2026-10-21).
func deny(reason string) {
	answer := `{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"` +
		reason + `"},"systemMessage":"segundo kit: negado"}`
	if _, err := fmt.Println(answer); err != nil {
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	if _, err := fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, reason); err != nil {
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	os.Exit(0)
}

func fail(reason string) {
	if _, err := fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, reason); err != nil {
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	os.Exit(2)
}
